run_kfac_autoencoder_training: run the KFAC optimizer training loop for a standard autoencoder model on random data
create_glorot_uniform_initializer: create a Glorot uniform weight initializer for neural network layers given a shape and RNG key
build_fully_connected_layer: build a fully connected layer that performs matrix multiplication and bias addition on input data
initialize_autoencoder_model: initialize a standard autoencoder model with configurable encoder layer sizes and Glorot uniform weights
evaluate_model_loss: evaluate the autoencoder model loss with L2 regularization and return mean squared error as auxiliary output
